meta.title: Provider Neutrality
meta.subtitle: Engine → one internal LLM protocol → three adapters; the kernel cannot import a vendor SDK

boundaries.label: noeta-runtime — no vendor SDK, no httpx, stdlib only
noeta.builtins.providers — reached only by dynamic ref

cards.title: The boundary is structural
items: noeta-runtime declares zero dependencies — no httpx, no vendor SDK, stdlib only
.importlinter's sdk-core-not-builtins contract forbids every static import of noeta.builtins
Every adapter lives in the providers built-in, so the kernel cannot reach one even by accident

cards.title: One protocol
items: LLMProvider is a single pure method: complete(LLMRequest) -> LLMResponse
Adapters never write the EventLog, never see a StepContext, and know nothing about resume
RuntimeLLMClient records LLMRequestStarted / LLMResponseRecorded / LLMRequestFinished, error path included

cards.title: Swapping is wiring, not identity
items: Options.provider or Client(provider=…) — excluded from AgentSpec identity and from equality
Import path: noeta.sdk.providers, a lazy re-export so only a network host pays for httpx
CATALOG carries each model's context window, output cap, and pricing

cards.title: What an adapter owns
items: Translating the noeta-shape Message / Block vocabulary to and from the vendor wire
Host injections: Anthropic wraps them in system-reminder tags, openai_compat renders mid-history system turns
Streaming, retry classification, usage accounting, and context-overflow detection
